command: claude --permission-mode auto (interactive TUI, driven under a pty), prompted to dispatch a Task subagent
note: The CHILD's own transcript, which is where `attributionAgent` lives — the parent's had zero. Its hooks are deliberately NOT shipped here: CC's hook transcript_path always points at the PARENT, so hooks and this transcript key to different sessions and could not share a one-AgentId scenario. The recorder's own roster and instruction attachments rode fields no decoder reads and are stripped (see `deidentified`).
